sourceReferences.use: Tansy BASE form, ONLY UPPER RIGHT: careful kind hedgehog with sage-green leafy quills and peach tips, cream furry face/belly, huge AMBER eyes, mint gardening apron with cream daisy emblem, coral sleeves, small green watering can. Keep these clothes, no cape or crown. Signature: gathers a loose tiny green vine in paws, extends a soft protective vine arch, then lets it settle. Watering can stays small and out of way during walk.

processing: Imagegen background-cleanup edit; original generation and edited source preserved. Public PNG copied byte-for-byte from edited source, no programmatic pixel edits. Runtime frame rectangles/ground anchors measured separately.

limitations: Directional idle is one still per heading, not a breathing/blink cycle.
